name.en: Robertson kinetics: ODE and conservation DAE

caption.ja: 短い固定区間でBDF2・SDIRK2・倍分割適応法を、資格済みRadau/BDF参照と比較します。 保存済みの数値場と参照を用いた図です。 図の軌道・状態・時刻・反復の軸は、物理空間の次元を表しません。
caption.en: Compare BDF2, SDIRK2 and adaptive step doubling on a short fixed interval against qualified Radau and BDF references. This preview reads saved numerical fields and references only. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions.

note.ja: 3成分の硬い反応ODEと、保存則を代数式に置き換えたindex-1 DAEを区別して比較します。
note.en: Distinguish the stiff three-species ODE from an index-one DAE obtained by replacing one equation with conservation.

note.ja: 整合初期化と微分・代数残差を扱う小規模な固定例です。一般DAEソルバーの完成を意味しません。
note.en: Small fixed examples expose consistent initialization and separate differential/algebraic residuals; this is not a general-purpose DAE solver.

equation_note.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。 モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。
equation_note.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs. Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct.

title.en: Robertson kinetics: initial stiffness and actual error

references.formula: \dot y_1=-0.04y_1+10^4y_2y_3,\quad\dot y_2=-\dot y_1-3\!\times\!10^7y_2^2,\quad\dot y_3=3\!\times\!10^7y_2^2;\quad \|r\|_{w,\infty}=\max_i|r_i|/w_i,\quad e_{\rm dbl}=(y_{h/2,h/2}-y_h)/3

assumptions.ja: 無次元3成分、初期値(1,0,0)、T=.4。固定512/1024/2048刻みと2許容誤差の適応法で計8run。
assumptions.en: A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. The fixed methods use 512, 1024 and 2048 steps; two adaptive tolerance settings bring the total to eight runs.

note.ja: 保存/正値性は固定入力の観測で、一般的な保証ではありません。T=.4の短時間・標本時刻での精度であり、長時間化学精度や全時刻誤差上限は主張しません。
note.en: Conservation and positivity are observations for these inputs, not universal guarantees. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

assumptions.ja: モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。
assumptions.en: Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct.

note.ja: 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。
note.en: Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule.

reference_note.ja: 22共通時刻の実誤差、全受理時刻の質量/最小値、真の段階残差、実RHS/Jacobian/因子/solve数を別判定します。 元39目標をすべて実測し、精度・細分化4目標の未達を変更せず研究結果として記録します。他35条件と独立参照・保存配列からの判定再計算は必須です。
reference_note.en: Check actual errors at 22 common times, mass and minimum values at every accepted state, true stage residuals, and actual RHS, Jacobian, factorization and linear-solve counts separately. Evaluate all 39 original targets, retaining the four unmet accuracy/refinement goals as study outcomes. The other 35 requirements, independent references and faithful saved-array recomputation remain mandatory.

method_note.ja: BDF2は同格子BE開始。SDIRK2の非線形段階は重み付き最大残差で判定し、同じ段階内だけJacobian因子を再利用。適応法はRMS倍分割誤差と2半刻みを採用。 解析Jacobian付き固定BE/Newtonを使い、質量の投影・濃度クリップはしません。
method_note.en: BDF2 starts with backward Euler on the same grid. SDIRK2 stages use a weighted maximum residual and reuse Jacobian factors only within one stage. Adaptive steps use an RMS step-doubling estimate and accept the two-half-step result. Use fixed BE/Newton with analytic Jacobians and no mass projection or concentration clipping.
